scripts.speaker: Neighborhood Grandmother
scripts.text: Hohoho- Seeing the young people sweating and working hard makes me feel a bit energized.

scripts.speaker: Neighborhood Grandmother
scripts.text: Oh, by the way. Did you know that?

scripts.speaker: Neighborhood Grandmother
scripts.text: Dummies in the training grounds that are strong against physical attacks have a sword icon above their heads, and dummies that are strong against magic attacks have a staff icon above their heads.

scripts.speaker: Neighborhood Grandmother
scripts.text: If you know this, you'll be able to hit them harder, right?

scripts.speaker: Fress
scripts.text: If you want to go to Prontera, you can exit through the guards located throughout the area or through the warp portals at 3 and 9 o'clock. Seriously.

scripts.speaker: Nine Oranges
scripts.text: Remember! Once you've chosen a name, it's hard to change, so choose wisely.

scripts.speaker: Nine Oranges
scripts.text: By the way, where's the Undead Dummy?

scripts.speaker: Nine Oranges
scripts.text: My friend said it has a bone icon above its head...? You have to see it first.

scripts.speaker: Village
scripts.text: Hi! The weather is really nice, isn't it? I came to check out the new training grounds.

scripts.speaker: Village
scripts.text: The old training grounds weren't bad, but they were actually renting space that beginners had been using for a long time, so there were some inconveniences.

scripts.speaker: Village
scripts.text: But they're building such a spacious and nice new training ground. It seems like they're quite financially sound these days!

scripts.speaker: Jar Cat
scripts.text: Is this your first time at the training grounds? I'll explain myself, as a veteran.

scripts.speaker: Jar Cat
scripts.text: There are three training grounds: the basic training ground, the 1/10 training ground, and the 1/100 training ground. I'll leave the differences between each training ground for you to discover for yourself.

scripts.speaker: Jar Cat
scripts.text: Oh, right! To move to another training ground, you can use the warp portals at 3 o'clock and 9 o'clock. Remember!

scripts.speaker: Little One
scripts.text: Dad told me! The Dummys with staff icons above their heads are strong against magic!

scripts.speaker: Little One
scripts.text: So... if you can defeat those Dummys with magic, you're truly strong, right?!

scripts.speaker: Kekekekereurur
scripts.text: They say training with the Dummys with cat icons above them will help you fight Doram in PvP.

scripts.speaker: Kekekekereurur
scripts.text: I'm definitely not practicing here after getting beat up by a passing Doram. Remember!

scripts.speaker: Lumberjack
scripts.text: Whoosh- Cha-Whoosh- Cha-

scripts.speaker: Dong
scripts.text: Aaaah- Stop! Stop! I'm not a monster. Don't attack me.

scripts.speaker: Dong
scripts.text: Whew- Thank you. Some people often mistake me for the monster Mukka, but I'm a cactus from a place called RockRidge.

scripts.speaker: Dong
scripts.text: If you visit RockRidge, you can meet our living, breathing Cacti, the Cactus. Come visit. Hahaha.
